info.title: rsp42 SM-DP+ management API
info.description: BSS/OSS-facing management API for the SM-DP+ (and, for /events, the SM-DS). Manages tenants, the profile inventory, the SAIP template registry, the ICCID pool and personalization. There is no authentication: the API is meant to be reachable only from the operator backend on an internal network (docs/esim42-integration-gaps.md §0.1-4). All list endpoints accept `page`, `size` and `tenant`.

tenant.name: tenant
tenant.description: Restrict to one tenant. Omit for all; an empty value selects the platform default.

idempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
idempotencyKey.description: Replays the first response for this key and repeats no side effect. Reuse with a different body is a 409.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, e.g. invalid_request, not_found, conflict, unknown_tenant, quota_exceeded.

id.description: The operator BSS carrier primary key; rsp42 keeps no second mapping.

iccid.description: Optional; the pool is used when omitted.

PoolEntriesPage.description: A page of pool entry records.

EIDsPage.description: A page of EID summary records.

EventsPage.description: A page of SM-DS event records.

AuditCursor.description: Cursor mode of GET /audit (?afterId=&limit=): no page/size, the caller continues from nextAfterId.

AuditResponse.description: GET /audit answers either the paginated page (default) or the cursor shape when ?afterId= is given.

delete.summary: Delete a tenant; refused with 409 tenant_in_use while it owns resources unless ?force=true&reassignTo=<tenant|""> migrates them first (N3)

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Migrate the tenant's resources to reassignTo and then delete.

parameters.name: reassignTo
parameters.description: Destination tenant for the migrated resources; an empty value means the platform-global scope. Must be a registered tenant.

400.description: unknown_tenant (unregistered reassignTo) or invalid_request (reassignTo equals the deleted tenant).

409.description: tenant_in_use: the response carries a top-level `usage` object.
